## Checklist

- [ ] `npm test`, `npm run test:lint` and `npm run validate` pass
- [ ] `npm run test:browser` passes, if the browser layer changed
- [ ] A gate, threshold or status change has a decision record in `docs/framework/DECISIONS.md`
- [ ] Generated files are rebuilt with `npm run build`, if rules or evaluator roles changed
- [ ] `CHANGELOG.md` has an entry under "Unreleased"
- [ ] The documents claim no more than the evidence shows (`docs/framework/AUTHORING.md`)
